headline: Employment is high everywhere at 92.6 %; Asia lags slightly and shows the most job-seeking.
how_to_read: Flows run from all respondents (left) to employed or not employed (middle) and then to detailed situation (right); width is the share of respondents. The hatched "Hidden" flow appears only in regional views, where retired and other situations are hidden for some regions.
key_findings: Pooled across n = 1,499 respondents, 74.9 % work full-time, 7.9 % part-time and 8.0 % are self-employed.
Of the 7.4 % not employed, 4.3 % are seeking work.
benchmark: Europe (93.2 %) and the Americas (93.0 %) are 1.9 pp and 1.7 pp above Asia (91.3 %) on employment. Asia's seeking-work share (6.6 %) is 3.6 pp above the Americas (3.0 %). Europe has the most part-time work (10.2 %), 5.3 pp above Asia (4.9 %).
caveats: Regional samples differ in size (Americas n = 328, Asia n = 426, Europe n = 745), and retired and other situations are hidden for the Americas and Asia (fewer than 3 people).
